programme.title: Murder by Medic

programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S02 E19 — A Ventriloquist Dummy Comes to Life and More An antique ventriloquist dummy is taken over by an otherworldly entity; a haunted hotel gives a ghost hunter the fright of his life; a woman's apartment is invaded by a ferocious shadow creature.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E02 — The Lost Girls In 1991, Vicky Hamilton and Dinah McNicol vanished six months apart. Their cases stayed cold until 2006, when Angelika Kluk's murder led to the arrest of Peter Tobin. DNA linked him to Vicky and Dinah, exposing him as an evil serial killer.
programme.title: Snatched

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries: Family Spirits

programme.desc: S01 E07 — San Andreas Superquakes The West coast is home to the infamous fault, the San Andreas. Stretching for almost a thousand miles beneath the feet of millions of Americans, but just north there is a larger fault that could trigger a megaquake, wreaking havoc across California.
programme.title: Brink of Disaster

programme.desc: Shag Harbour UFO Incident Examining the 1967 case in which residents of the Shag Harbour fishing community saw an object fall from the night sky and crash into the ocean.
